claims.claim: UK Used Sony PS4 Pro Console
claims.evidence: No readable brand/model text or logo visible in either photo; witness only identifies generic 'home gaming console' shape.
Witness explicitly notes no cables, controllers, power adapters, or original box are visible in either photo.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or function (common 'for parts' risk with used electronics)
risks.proof: Video of console powering on, booting to home screen, and reading a disc or digital title

risks.risk: Model/brand unconfirmed - could be base PS4, PS4 Slim, or unofficial/rebadged unit, not necessarily 'Pro'
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear/bottom label showing model number (e.g., CUH-7xxx for Pro) and serial sticker
risks.if_unproven: priced as lowest-spec generic console, not Pro

risks.risk: No controller, cables, or power adapter actually included despite seller's claim
risks.proof: Photo showing controller, HDMI cable, and power cord laid out next to the console(s)

risks.risk: Two distinct units shown (one slimmer, one flatter) but seller describes only a single console - mismatch in quantity/identity
risks.proof: Seller video or clarification showing both units together with explanation of what is being sold
risks.if_unproven: priced as uncertain bundle, worst case only one unverified unit counted

risks.risk: Storage capacity and internal condition unknown
risks.proof: Photo of system storage/settings screen or opened unit showing drive

risks.risk: Possible jailbreak, region lock, or account lock affecting resale value
risks.proof: Video of system settings menu showing firmware version and account status

risks.risk: Watermarked 'McSteve/Jiji' photos may be reused stock images from an online store rather than the actual item
risks.proof: Fresh photo with a handwritten date/name note alongside the console

proof_requests: Close-up of rear label/model number and serial sticker
Power-on video showing boot to home screen
Photo of all included accessories (controller, cables, power adapter) together with the console(s)
Clarification on whether one or two consoles are for sale, with both shown together
Video of system settings showing storage, firmware, and account status
response.reason: Witness confirms it is a used home gaming console, so it can be priced at worst case (unconfirmed model, no accessories, unverified function), but seller's 'PS4 Pro' and 'with controller' claims are unverifiable or contradicted by the photos.
